method_notes.rounding_order: Round RGB white shares to three decimals before computing the one-decimal white_ratio; round RGB spread, Sentinel-1 mean change, and rain max/mean ratio to one decimal.
method_notes.s1_definition: s1_mean_change_db is the package Sentinel-1 VV post-minus-pre mean-change statistic.
method_notes.side_product_scope: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and rainfall values are side metrics for observation-window interpretation, not measured surface damage.
